scope: Optional immutable event trace context; traceparent-only v0.1 approved by controller.

fields.traceparent: W3C Trace Context, validated and normalized by the OpenTelemetry SDK

privacy: This version deliberately omits tracestate because it is opaque and could contain private vendor data. Do not store or propagate JWT, sid, passwords, personal payloads or baggage in traceContext.
producer: At the time the immutable fact is recorded call EventTraceContext.captureCurrent(); persist traceparent with that fact. If no valid current context, omit traceContext.
relay: Transmit the stored immutable traceparent unchanged on each retry. Never capture the relay thread as the event producer.
consumer: Validate with EventTraceContext.fromStored, then startConsumer with the persisted context and a bounded operation name and delivery attempt. Missing or invalid context starts a new root, never inherits ambient relay/consumer-thread context. End the returned span.
delivery: At-least-once retries may create multiple consumer spans, each with knode.event.delivery_attempt >= 1 and the same producer parent. Span export is best effort and does not prove business delivery.
integration: Java API and synthetic fixtures verified. User v2 producer wiring and real User Outbox to Redis Stream consumer chain remain pending.
compatibility: The existing EventTraceContext methods and traceparent-only semantics remain unchanged; tracestate and baggage are not accepted in this version.
